launcher-add-deck.title: Empty deck
launcher-add-deck.text: Starts with nothing. Add instruments from the Hub, or drivers already installed.

launcher-add-deck.title: From a Python script
launcher-add-deck.text: A script that ends in ivoryos_edge.run(), run as it is. Dropping a .py file on the window does the same.

launcher-add-driver.title: Module and class
launcher-add-driver.text: As in the import you would write: from vendor_pumps.syringe import SyringePump.

launcher-add-driver.title: Arguments
launcher-add-driver.text: What its constructor takes, such as a port.

launcher-deck.title: Start, then open
launcher-deck.text: Start runs the deck. Open shows its page in a tab; the arrow beside it, in your browser.

launcher-deck.title: Three tabs
launcher-deck.text: What is on the deck, what it printed, and how it runs.

launcher-deck.title: Add instruments
launcher-deck.text: From the Hub, or a class the app's Python can already import.

launcher-deck.title: Each instrument
launcher-deck.text: Switch it off without removing it, edit its arguments, or delete it.

launcher-deck-settings.title: Start with the app
launcher-deck-settings.text: Ticked, this deck starts whenever IvoryOS opens.

launcher-deck-settings.title: On the network
launcher-deck-settings.text: On, lab mates open this deck from their own browsers. Off, this computer only.

launcher-deck-settings.title: On disk
launcher-deck-settings.text: The deck file, which lists its instruments, and the folder with its runs and workflows.

launcher-deck-settings.title: Optimizers
launcher-deck-settings.text: Pick a version to add Ax, BayBE or NIMO to this deck, then Apply.

launcher-failed.title: Red in the list
launcher-failed.text: A deck that could not start stays marked until it does.

launcher-failed.title: What went wrong
launcher-failed.text: The reason in a line, with See log for the rest and Send to IvoryOS if you cannot fix it.

launcher-failed.title: The log
launcher-failed.text: Its last lines usually name the cause: here, a driver package that is not installed.

launcher-hub.title: Public or private
launcher-hub.text: Private is what only your organization can see. It needs an account.

launcher-hub.title: Four kinds
launcher-hub.text: A driver, a whole lab, a page added to a deck, or a ready-made workflow.

launcher-hub.title: Search
launcher-hub.text: By instrument, vendor or package name.

launcher-hub.title: Tested
launcher-hub.text: Its contributor has run it with IvoryOS.

launcher-hub-driver.title: What it installs
launcher-hub-driver.text: The package, and the class the deck will build from it.

launcher-hub-driver.title: Instrument name
launcher-hub-driver.text: What steps call it. Two of the same instrument get two names.

launcher-hub-driver.title: Settings
launcher-hub-driver.text: What the driver needs to connect, such as a port, typed as its author declared.

launcher-hub-driver.title: Add to deck
launcher-hub-driver.text: Installs the package and adds the instrument to the deck named in the title.

launcher-log.title: Follow
launcher-log.text: Keeps the newest line in view.

launcher-log.title: Copy, or the file
launcher-log.text: This session's lines, or the file that has every earlier session too.

launcher-log.title: Send to IvoryOS
launcher-log.text: A report with this log. You read all of it before anything is sent.

launcher-platform.title: Where it goes
launcher-platform.text: A deck of its own. Opened from a deck's Add from Hub, it can join that deck instead.

launcher-platform.title: Deck name
launcher-platform.text: Shown in the sidebar. Change it now or later.

launcher-platform.title: Instruments
launcher-platform.text: Untick what you do not have. The name in the box is what steps call it.

launcher-platform-confirm.title: Read, then install
launcher-platform-confirm.text: The packages, instruments, plugins and workflows about to be added. Drivers run on this computer.

launcher-platform-options.title: Plugins
launcher-platform-options.text: Pages the platform adds to the deck, such as a live view of the lab.

launcher-platform-options.title: Workflows
launcher-platform-options.text: Ready-made workflows, put in the new deck's Library.

launcher-platform-options.title: Optimizers
launcher-platform-options.text: For the Optimize page. Tick one and keep the recommended version.

launcher-platform-options.title: Install
launcher-platform-options.text: Everything ticked is installed together, after you confirm.

launcher-report.title: Say what happened
launcher-report.text: Optional, and the most useful part.

launcher-report.title: Read it first
launcher-report.text: The log, the deck's instrument names and the Python environment. Keys, emails and your home folder are masked. Edit anything.

launcher-report.title: Send
launcher-report.text: Goes to the IvoryOS team, with an id you keep as a reference.

launcher-script.title: The same buttons
launcher-script.text: A script profile starts, stops and opens like a deck.

launcher-script.title: Four tabs
launcher-script.text: Code edits the script here. Its settings are under Configuration.

launcher-script.title: The script
launcher-script.text: The file this profile runs. The buttons open it for editing, or show it in its folder.

launcher-script-code.title: Instruments
launcher-script-code.text: Every instrument object in the script becomes a device, named after its variable.

launcher-script-code.title: Save and restart
launcher-script-code.text: Changes apply when the script starts again.

launcher-script-settings.title: Advanced
launcher-script-settings.text: Another Python interpreter, a working folder, environment variables. All of it can stay empty.

launcher-script-settings.title: Name and port
launcher-script-settings.text: The port its page is served on. Change it if another program has it.

launcher-script-settings.title: On the network
launcher-script-settings.text: On, lab mates open this deck from their own browsers. Off, this computer only.

launcher-settings.title: One theme
launcher-settings.text: The launcher, every deck's page and Cloud follow it.

launcher-settings.title: Help
launcher-settings.text: Send a report to the IvoryOS team, or ask on Discord.

launcher-settings.title: Needs you
launcher-settings.text: Told at once, with a sound: a run waiting, a failed step, a deck that stopped.

launcher-settings.title: Long runs only
launcher-settings.text: A finished run is announced when it took at least this long.

launcher-settings-python.title: Updates
launcher-settings-python.text: The version installed. An installed app offers new ones here.

launcher-settings-python.title: The app's Python
launcher-settings-python.text: Deck profiles run in it. Copy path gives it to PyCharm or VS Code as an interpreter.

launcher-settings-python.title: Rebuild
launcher-settings-python.text: Sets the environment up again from nothing, if it ever breaks.

launcher-settings-python.title: Everything on disk
launcher-settings-python.text: Profiles, each deck's runs and workflows, and logs are in this one folder.

launcher-sidebar.title: A running deck
launcher-sidebar.text: Green means running. Click the row to show its page; the gear shows its instruments, log and settings.

launcher-sidebar.title: More decks
launcher-sidebar.text: Any number can run at once, each on its own port.

launcher-tab.title: This page
launcher-tab.text: Hide the sidebar, reload the page, or close it. A closed deck keeps running.

launcher-tab.title: The deck's own pages
launcher-tab.text: Everything in this bar belongs to the deck that is open.

launcher-welcome.title: Browse the Hub
launcher-welcome.text: Drivers, whole labs and workflows that others have shared. The usual place to start.

launcher-welcome.title: Add a deck
launcher-welcome.text: An empty deck, or a Python script you already run.

launcher-welcome.title: Try the example
launcher-welcome.text: A simulated lab. Nothing to plug in.

launcher-welcome.title: Always here
launcher-welcome.text: The same choices stay in the sidebar once you have decks.
